issues.description: Method name mismatch for the QFT-on-n-qubits entry point: the template (template_repository/ex2_qft.py) declares the stub as `_qft_circuit_n_qubits(self, qc)` (line 7) while the solution implementation (solution_repository/ex2_qft.py) and the exercise/task wording reference `qft_circuit_n_qubits(self, qc)` (no leading underscore). This inconsistent public identifier will confuse students and break automated tests that expect the public name `qft_circuit_n_qubits`, because students following the template may implement the underscored name or tests may not find their implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public method name consistent across artifacts. Prefer exposing the public name `qft_circuit_n_qubits` in the template: rename the template method from `_qft_circuit_n_qubits` to `qft_circuit_n_qubits`, or add a public wrapper `def qft_circuit_n_qubits(self, qc): return self._qft_circuit_n_qubits(qc)`. Also ensure the problem statement/tests reference the same public name.
